resources.string: Tell the vault your name to host or join.
Your phone opens a room. Everyone else joins from their own phone.
Find a room someone nearby has opened.
One phone, passed around the table. Works anywhere.
The vault needs to find the others
Phones in this room talk to each other over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. No internet, and the vault never asks where you are. Android will ask you to allow nearby devices.
Without nearby devices, phones can\'t find each other. You can still play by passing one phone around.
Android won\'t ask again. Allow \"Nearby devices\" in this app\'s settings, then come back.
Waiting for players. Everyone else opens Join a game.

resources.string: Everyone has a seat. Rounds over the network are still being built, so tonight ends here. Pass one phone around to play for real.
Turn on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, then try again.
Turn on location services, then try again. Older Android needs it to find nearby phones.
That room just went out of reach.
Something went wrong with the radio. Try again.
Stay close to the host. The room appears here when their phone is in reach.
Someone in that room already goes by that name.
Waiting for %1$s to open the vault.
Lost the host. Trying to get back in; your seat is kept for a minute.
This phone speaks vault protocol %1$s, but the host speaks %2$s. Update both phones to the same version of Minority Vault.
The host runs a different version of Minority Vault. Update both phones to the same version.
Couldn\'t get into that room. Move closer to the host and try again.
